 Misc. Criminal Case No. 27636 of 2024
 Sourabh Ode
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Sourabh Singh Thakur - Advocate For Applicant.
 Shri G.S. Thakur - Government Advocate For Respondent-
 State.
 Order

This is the first bail application filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 on behalf of applicant for grant of regular bail relating to F IR No.178/2024, registered at Police Station Obedullaganj, District Raisen (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 366,
376(2)(N) of the IPC and Section 5-L, 6 of the POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 04/06/2024.
He is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is submitted that the prosecutrix is more than 16 years of age and there was love relationship between the applicant and prosecutrix and on the false ground FIR has been lodged.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3 . Learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondent/State opposed the bail application.
It is submitted that the prosecutrix is 16 years and 11 months of age.
Applicant committed rape on the prosecutrix by giving false pretext of marriage.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be released on 2 MCRC-27636-2024 bail.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that there is delay in lodging FIR and prosecutrix is more than 16 years of age and there was love relationship between the applicant and prosecutrix, without commenting on the merits of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.
